# language-detect-lite

> Dependency-free language detection with character trigram profiles and the Cavnar-Trenkle out-of-place distance, six bundled languages and trainable custom profiles Python package `trysac-language-detect-lite`, import name `language_detect_lite`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
